about_the_game:
You play as a courier stuck in an old soviet house.
The demo contains only a small part of the game - one apartment into which you fall trying to get out from the floor above.
It takes 15-20 minutes to complete.

Matreshka is a series of horrors in a Soviet atmosphere.

Navigate between floors, avoid the locals, and escape the building alive.



Challenging Puzzles
Solve intricate puzzles that require logic, observation, and creativity. Each solution brings you one step closer to freedom but also deeper into the building's mysteries.


Immersive Atmosphere
Explore a meticulously recreated Soviet-era building, filled with authentic details and a haunting atmosphere that brings history to life.


Interactive Environment
Every floor presents unique challenges and interactive elements. Search for clues, collect useful items, and manipulate the environment to uncover the building's secrets.


Locals
Beware of the building's inhabitants, whose behaviors and motives are unpredictable. Some may help, others may hinder, and a few might be outright dangerous.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 2040

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: MATRESHKA is a first-person psychological horror experience, you need to find a way to escape from a maze of old soviet buildings.
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
